title: Lost opportunities, investment, and duplicated recovery
shortTitle: Lost opportunities, investment, and duplicated recovery
summary: The notes contrast sunk expenditures, promised profits, alternative opportunities, and the value of a payment returned.
notes: In the Mount Pleasant discussion, which proposed awards would compensate the same expenditure twice? How do the Pond and other examples treat opportunities forgone? In the land and lottery variants, does a later change in value change the chosen interest? Keep the cause of action and remedy measure separate.
